# jcdcdev.Umbraco.GroupsToTabs

[![Umbraco Marketplace](https://img.shields.io/badge/Umbraco Marketplace-%23f5c1bc?logo=umbraco&logoColor=162335)](https://marketplace.umbraco.com/package/jcdcdev.Umbraco.GroupsToTabs)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-1?logo=github&color=232925)](https://github.com/jcdcdev/jcdcdev.Umbraco.GroupsToTabs)
[![NuGet Downloads](https://img.shields.io/nuget/dt/jcdcdev.Umbraco.GroupsToTabs?labelColor=4536d3&color=4536d3&label=NuGet&logo=nuget)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/jcdcdev.Umbraco.GroupsToTabs)
[![Project Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Project Website-jcdcdev?color=3c4834&logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,)](https://jcdc.dev/umbraco-packages/groups-to-tabs)


A simple Umbraco package that converts content type groups into tabs in the Umbraco backoffice.

> [!NOTE]
> This package was created to celebrate [Hacktoberfest](https://umbraco.com/blog/join-us-for-umbraco-hacktoberfest-2024/) 2024! 🎉

> [!WARNING]
> Version 15 is no longer supported and is End of Life (EOL).

> Please review the [security policy](https://github.com/jcdcdev/jcdcdev.Umbraco.GroupsToTabs?tab=security-ov-file#supported-versions) for more information.
